The functional unit is one complete metal-working factory infrastructure, including buildings, internal roads/parking and land occupation, not one kg of metalworking or factory operation. Source documents 43,675 tonnes annual output and a 50-year lifetime; the stated 4.58e-10 factory units per kg belongs to the caller allocation, not another multiplier when replacing its factory-unit demand. Do not multiply/divide by lifetime, annual output, land area or that per-kg factor again, and do not add machine processing, operation or infrastructure already present.

Native split land entries sum to the source aggregated entries; preserve its complete native inventory without treating those splits as duplicate occupation. Source global building/road supply becomes native Swiss supply despite the European factory label. Building/road composition, geography, emissions, age and uncertainty can differ.

This is the complete cold-sheet-rolling service for unalloyed/low-alloyed steel per kg, including pickling, cold rolling, annealing, tempering, finishing, packing and roll maintenance. Source and native2026 documentation exclude the main metal blank being rolled; the shorter native2025 comment identifies the same cold-rolling service and its inventory has only the matching small auxiliary steel quantities: keep the caller supplied steel separately. Small internal replacement/auxiliary steel quantities (0.0855 kg unalloyed and 0.000236 kg low-alloyed) and 1.62e-9 rolling-mill units remain inside the complete service; do not mistake them for the main blank or subtract/add another kg. This permission does not cover high-alloy steel, aluminium rolling or sale of a finished steel sheet.

Native uses 0.223 kWh ENTSO-E electricity, 0.912 MJ natural-gas combustion and 0.171 MJ unspecific chemical-plant heat, with 0.804 MJ waste heat. Source uses 0.22438168 kWh electricity and 0.99636 plus 0.0725382 MJ useful-heat supplies. Fuel-input MJ and purchased useful-heat MJ have different reference boundaries: no efficiency ratio or extra energy/emission correction is inferred. Native European/Swiss utilities, internal freight, treatment and vintage are screening approximations.

Both source/native list 0.000397 kg of their own hydrochloric-acid input, but source labels kg acid without water in solution and native labels 30% aqueous product. This complete-service proxy retains that internal concentration-boundary difference explicitly; it does not approve standalone acid kg equivalence, silently correct its inventory, or add solution water/acid on top. Sludge, steel-bearing shredder residue, furnace wastes, waste oil and packaging use native complete treatment portfolios, with different moisture/geography/allocation and internal signs. Keep those original native quantities without a recovery credit. Direct emissions/water and internal uncertainty can differ; effects remain unquantified.
